hints: Check the pH after you add the base. Neutral is pH 7. Is it there yet, or still below?

Base cancels acid bit by bit, like dancers pairing up. Each base particle pairs with one acid particle. Here it takes 25 mL of base to pair up with all the acid. With less, some acid is left over, so it's still acidic.
Set the base to exactly 25 mL and run it. Then try 35 mL and watch what the pH does.
